gazette_location.description_raw_en: Street commencing at its junction with FUNG CHEUNG ROAD and running in an easterly direction for about 90 metres then curving to run northerly for about 265 metres where it terminates at its junction with FUNG YAU STREET NORTH as shown coloured grey on Drawing No. NTA/YL/R28C.

gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此街由與鳳攸南街交界處起，然後順屈向北伸展約一百三十六米，再朝向西北伸展約七十米，至與鳳攸北街交界處終止，在 NTA/YL/R28C 號圖則上以紅色間以黑綫顯示。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Street commencing at its junction with FUNG YAU STREET EAST and running in a westerly direction for about 169 metres to terminate at its junction with FUNG KAM STREET as shown coloured blue on Drawing No. NTA/YL/R28C.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此街由與鳳攸東街交界處起，向西伸展約一百六十九米，至與鳳琴街交界處終止，在 NTA/YL/R28C 號圖則上以藍色顯示。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Street commencing at its junction with FUNG KAM STREET and running in a westerly direction for about 55 metres then curving to run southerly for about 115 metres to terminate at its closed end as shown coloured light blue on Drawing No. NTA/YL/R28C.

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Street commencing at its junction with CASTLE PEAK ROAD YUEN LONG and running southerly for about 275 metres to terminate at its junction with HOP YICK ROAD as shown hatched black and coloured dark brown on Drawing No. NTA/YL/R28C. (It should be noted that the part of the street as shown hatched black will be reconstructed.)

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Street commencing at its junction with FUNG CHEUNG ROAD and running in a westerly direction for about 82 metres where it terminates temporarily as shown coloured light yellow on Drawing No. NTA/YL/R28C. (It should be noted that there is a future extension of this street of about 30 metres in a westerly direction as shown hatched black on the said Drawing.)
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此街由與鳳翔路交界處起向西伸展約八十二米處暫時終止，在 NTA/YL/R28C 號圖則上以淺黃色顯示。(註：此街將會向西延長三十米，在上述圖則上以黑影綫顯示。)

(It should be noted that the part of the street as shown hatched green is not yet constructed and there is a future extension of this street of about 140 metres as shown hatched black on the said Drawing.)

(It should be noted that the part of the street running southerly and as shown hatched black on the said Drawing is not yet constructed.)

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Street commencing at its junction with KAU YUK ROAD and running in a southerly direction for about 140 metres where it terminates temporarily as shown coloured apple green on Drawing No. NTA/YL/R28C. (It should be noted that the part of the street running westerly and as shown hatched black on the said Drawing is not yet constructed.)
